assist.authorityBoundary: No numeric underwriting, risk score, canonical score, rank, tick, membership or Chief decision is created here.

claims.claim: Customer and government concentration is a source-addressed execution risk: the 2025 S-1 reports one customer at 78% of accounts receivable at year-end, two customers at 60% and 12% of 2025 revenue, and substantial exposure to government procurement and budget conditions.

The concentration risk persisted into 2026: the Q1 2026 10-Q reports government customers at 85% of quarterly revenue, making diversification of commercial demand a material falsifier for concentration-risk improvement.

Capital structure adds dilution sensitivity: immediately after the business combination Infleqtion had 216,471,927 common shares and 10,424,967 warrants outstanding; the same filing describes $528.2 million of gross transaction proceeds, which materially improves liquidity but does not eliminate warrant/equity dilution pathways.

risks: High government/customer concentration can amplify procurement, budget and contract-timing volatility.
Large post-combination liquidity supports execution capacity, while outstanding warrants and future capital needs preserve a per-share dilution pathway.

contradictions.observed: Strong liquidity and commercialization progress coexist with concentrated revenue sources and technically forward-looking quantum milestones.
contradictions.disposition: Risk clarification, not a present blocker by itself; Alpha should quantify how concentration and dilution affect score-risk evidence.

unknowns: Current post-Q2 customer concentration by revenue and receivables is not established by this assist artifact.
The timing and magnitude of future warrant exercise or new financing is uncertain.
improvementPaths: Evidence of a broader recurring commercial customer mix would reduce concentration sensitivity.
Demonstrated conversion of technical milestones into diversified contract revenue would improve scenario resilience.
Clear disclosure of cash runway, burn and fully diluted share evolution would reduce financing uncertainty.
falsifiers: A materially diversified customer mix with lower government dependence would weaken the concentration-risk thesis.
Sustained operating cash generation sufficient to fund the roadmap without material new equity issuance would weaken dilution-risk concerns.

gatingStatus.recommendedNextState: Alpha re-evaluates source-addressed score-risk evidence using the new concentration and dilution inputs.
